content: Upper Jhelum Canal Sargodha ke paas band toot gayi! University ke paas ke gaon mein paani ghus gaya hai. Khet aur ghar dono doob rahe hain. Urgent help chahiye! #SargodhaFlood
Canal breach near Satellite Town Sargodha. 3 villages flooded. University Road pe paani. NDMA ko foran inform karo.
Sargodha outskirts mein bari aandhi aa rahi hai — kheton mein faslon ko nuksan ho raha hai. Kisanon ke liye bara masla. Fasal barbaad hogi.

PDMA Punjab Sargodha: Canal breach confirmed at Upper Jhelum Canal km-42 near University Road. Breach length 18 metres. 3 villages inundated — Chak No 80 NB, 81 NB, 82 NB. 230 households evacuated. NDMA teams en route.

Agriculture Dept Sargodha: Dust storm from SW at 55km/h damaged standing wheat crop in 12 villages. Preliminary estimate: 4,200 acres affected, PKR 85M crop loss. Irrigation canals carrying debris — silt blockage risk.
University Road Sargodha — partial flooding. Speed 5km/h (normal 60km/h). Canal water spreading across road near Satellite Town.

Irrigation Dept Sargodha — Canal Level Gauge CLG-UJC-42: Upper Jhelum Canal water level 2.4m above design capacity. Flow rate 3,200 cusecs (normal: 1,200 cusecs). Breach confirmed — downstream pressure continuing.
Rescue 1122 Sargodha: 19 calls — 7 families stranded in Chak 80 NB. Canal water rising. Tractor rescue requested — boats unavailable in station.
Sargodha: Dust storm from west. 55km/h winds. Canal levels rising from upstream rainfall. 31°C temperature. Agricultural damage ongoing.
